entries.en: one's wife's family; relatives on the wife's side.
powerful family; kin of a mandarin (official).
entries.notes: 西语「parientes del Mandarin」与「勢家」为意译关系，非逐字对应。

entries.zh: 同族侄子；族中的晚辈亲属。
entries.en: clan nephew; a junior kinsman of the same lineage.
entries.notes: 西语作「国王的亲属」，与「族姪」不完全对应，且第二字有 [疑]。

entries.en: poor relation; member of a humble clan.
mother-in-law (the husband's mother).

entries.zh: 殿下；国王的近亲（王子、亲王）。
entries.en: His Highness; a prince, close kinsman of the king.
to give birth, to bear (a child).
to give birth; (of a woman) to bear a male child.

entries.zh: 分娩（「分」为「分娩」的首字，词条残去后字）。
entries.en: to give birth (分 is only the first syllable of 分娩 'childbirth').
entries.notes: 汉字栏仅存「分」，须依音写 hŭn 及西语 parir 补足为「分娩」。

entries.en: to give birth (to a male child).
entries.notes: 首字有 [疑]（妨/分）；据音写 hún Biē̃ 与西语定为「分娩」。

entries.en: to bear a child; to give birth.

entries.zh: 月内；分娩后一个月内（坐月子）。
entries.en: the month following childbirth; lying-in period.
to talk, to converse; to communicate.
[Original damaged; gloss uncertain]
entries.notes: 汉字、音写、官话三栏皆空，西语词头亦残损（「Partida y hir pahcon. papera」），无法定夺。

entries.en: eyelid.
entries.notes: 第三字有 [疑]（腘/肚），据「目睭」与西语 párpado 定为眼睑。

entries.en: eyelid.
part or division of a book; paragraph.
entries.notes: 音写 chăr 与「部」不相应，西语 párrafo 亦仅大意相通。

entries.en: paragraph, section.

entries.zh: 段落（原件作「揮字」，与 párrafo 的对应不明，释义存疑）。
entries.en: paragraph of a book (characters read 揮字 'wielded characters'; correspondence uncertain).
entries.notes: 汉字与西语 párrafo 无法直接对应，音写 húy xŷ 仅可证第二字为「字」。

entries.en: gridiron, grill (an iron grate for roasting).
entries.notes: 首字有 [疑]（鐵/鉗），次字「焙」指火上烘烤，据西语 parrillas 定为烤架。
